prompts.texto: abstract liquid gradient swirling into a soft spiral, soft mint green bleeding into deep emerald and pale cream, silky smooth color transitions, no texture, no grain, studio lighting, ultra clean, vertical composition --ar 9:16 --style raw --v 7
The gradient slowly rotates clockwise like ink swirling in water, colors breathe and blend continuously, camera completely static, seamless loop, calm and hypnotic motion, no cuts

notas:
El truco está en pedir “no texture, no grain” en la imagen. Si no, Kling mete ruido al animar y la espiral se ve sucia.

En Kling usé el modo profesional a 5 segundos y luego hice el loop en CapCut duplicando el clip en reversa.
